R6 holdReleasePreview: restarts and out_of_view by may name: an administrator at a hidden project's EXISTENCE is shown it and nothing is out of view; a member is told only that something is
R7 projectHolds: an administrator at a hidden project's EXISTENCE is answered held with since and recorded_by, all this read names; a member who may not name it is answered null, as absent

R2 R13 a hold records the place's own project and those named; it covers every in_place statement's since its last release; answers and reads show only what the viewer may name

R6 holdReleasePreview: refusals in R6's order; restarts what no other hold covers, the viewer's share with out_of_view; equals what the release records; writes nothing
R7 projectHolds: 1 to 50 distinct project ids (C-149.4); held with since and recorded_by, false, or null when absent or not one the viewer may name; never false on a failed read; writes nothing

R13 a machine credential never marks pressure, places or releases a hold, records a hold notice or a pressure record; the tables are this module's, keyed and purged; an invisible action or project reads as absent

R20 action-holds declares actionholdrelease: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R20 action-holds declares holdnoticesent: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R20 action-holds declares actionpressure: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R20 action-holds declares pressurerecord: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused

R22 placed-and-released fixture control: a viewer who sees no project reads no place
R2 an administrator neither invited nor joined may name a hidden project in a hold (D54): it lands, covering it; a member who may not name one is still refused
R2 the read shows each hold statement with those of its projects the viewer may name: an administrator's hidden projects at EXISTENCE included, a member's not
R5 actionHoldRelease answers restarted as those the author may name: an administrator's hidden projects included; a member's answer leaves them out, and the statement records them whatever she sees
R6 holdReleasePreview: restarts and out_of_view by may name: an administrator at a hidden project's EXISTENCE is shown it and nothing is out of view; a member is told only that something is
R7 projectHolds: an administrator at a hidden project's EXISTENCE is answered held with since and recorded_by, all this read names; a member who may not name it is answered null, as absent
R8 holdsReleased: restarted as those the viewer may name, an administrator's hidden projects at EXISTENCE included; a member's never; a project place's release listed to whoever may name the project
R9 purgeHeld reads every hold and every bundle's project whatever any viewer may see: a hidden project no administrator was added to is held as any other
R2 actionHold: refusals in R2's order, each with its row (C-149.1-.4, .8) and a negative control; nothing written
R2 in_place then released: both statements kept, the latest stands; pressureFor shows a legal mark's holds oldest first; the op and the purge
R2 R13 a hold records the place's own project and those named; it covers every in_place statement's since its last release; answers and reads show only what the viewer may name
R5 actionHoldRelease: refusals in R5's order (C-149.5), a release with none stated, and restarted recorded whatever the author sees
R6 holdReleasePreview: refusals in R6's order; restarts what no other hold covers, the viewer's share with out_of_view; equals what the release records; writes nothing
R7 projectHolds: 1 to 50 distinct project ids (C-149.4); held with since and recorded_by, false, or null when absent or not one the viewer may name; never false on a failed read; writes nothing
R8 holdsReleased: each release that ended a hold in place, with its placers and the restarted the viewer may name; never an invisible action; pages with cursor
R8 holdsReleased pages at 500 in (action, position, sequence) order; paging through each cursor reaches every release

R9 purgeHeld: false with no hold in place; the whole store, a held project, its material, an action carrying a hold and an undeterminable bundle while one stands; true when unreadable; never throws or writes
R22 holdsPlaced lists a place a hold was stated at, with its latest hold, from, and covered projects; a hold placed from a docket mark is found after holdsDue drops it
R22 holdsPlaced lists action and entry places in order, released ones as released, and pages with a cursor; an invisible action is in no page
R5 R6 a hold placed from a docket mark is previewed and released with the body that placed it, and reads released; a from naming none is refused
R5 R6 R2 a hold placed from a pressure record: holdsOf takes {pressure}, preview and release take its from, and pressureFor reads its hold released

R2 places: an action, an entry of one, a project or a case's project, each its own place with its own hold; exactly one place, else HOLD_PLACE_REFUSED after NO_TARGET; a hold on an action with no pressure mark lands

R2 from: a pressure mark, a pressure record, a docket legal mark or a counsel matter, standing at the place, recorded with the statement; anything else HOLD_FROM_REFUSED after the place's own refusals

R11 holdNoticeSent: refusals in R11's order (C-149.10, .11); a hold in place takes the record, held as bytes or her account; a released one is refused; nothing about any recipient is recorded or answered

R12 pressureRecord: refusals in R12's order; a record lands in a project the member sees at FULL with no action created; pressureFor lists marks and records together, each with where it arrived, paged

R13 a machine credential never marks pressure, places or releases a hold, records a hold notice or a pressure record; the tables are this module's, keyed and purged; an invisible action or project reads as absent

R1 pressure: marked on a received entry by a member, with actionCorrespond or later by actionPressure; never rewritten; read apart, the entry's through actionRead; pressureFor lists the actions holding one

R16 pressurefor op: answers exactly what pressureFor answers (marks by actionpressure and stated with an entry, and pressure records); an action or project the viewer may not see is answered as an absent one; writes nothing

R4 a reader whose read fails answers true, so doorbell may not clear; the reader writes nothing and never throws
R4 registered once per host: a second actionHoldsOf registers nothing, and doorbell holds the one reader, this module's; a doorbell given none holds none

R4 R10 R13 the copy window has ended (reconciliation R19; B5): actions registers neither reader and declares none of the hold tables; this module holds both registrations and all five declarations, and one held by actions is now a fault of the wiring
R4 R9 the whole-store purge answers exactly as the litigation-hold reader, in every hold state and when the holds cannot be read
R10 at start this module registers once with ratification.registerHoldReader a reader holdsOn({project}); a second actionHoldsOf registers nothing
R10 holdsOn answers R7's answer for one project read as the plane, whatever the viewer: held with since and recorded_by, or false after reading every hold; it names no action, entry or reason
R10 holdsOn answers null when it cannot complete the read (no project named, the holds unreadable), never false; it writes nothing and never throws

R10 against ratification R45 (M-T45-7, S1 §D 11): with no reader op=publishat answers SCHEDULE_UNCHECKABLE; with this module's reader registered it no longer does, checked records the holds it answers, and a hold placed since signing stops the scheduled publication
R17 shared codes: CAPTURE_AND_TESTIMONY, NEITHER_CAPTURE_NOR_TESTIMONY and UNREGISTERED_ARTIFACT equal action-records' answer from holdNoticeSent and pressureRecord; a well-formed act is not refused
R15 C-149.10 MACHINE_CANNOT_SEND reads words.json's refusal.MACHINE_CANNOT_SEND by key from ACTION_HOLDS_WORDS, never a copy; its code, number and where unmoved; answered at the act
R15 C-149.11 HOLD_NOT_IN_PLACE and C-149.8 HOLD_PLACE_REFUSED keep their present translations, not words.json's; no other row's check, where or translation moved

R18 pressureFor with an action states the governing view's threat_letter facts for its kind once, each with its source and the label, only when the action holds a legal mark; a retaliation mark alone states none
R18 a governingView that cannot be read answers facts null with why, never an empty list
R18 pressureFor rows carry by and hold: the latest statement at a mark's entry or placed from it, and at a record placed from it; null while none

R19 holdsOf takes {docket_entry}: the place of a docket legal mark is its case's project; an entry the viewer may not see, or marked otherwise, is no place; two places are refused
